item.name: Cutting_Boards
item.description: Nonporous cutting boards used only for cheese preparation.
item.readyBeforeUse: Each board is clean, sanitized, air-dry, and free of deep cuts or cracks.
item.readyForNextPerson: During service, each board is clean and remains on the protected work surface. After service, each is washed, rinsed, sanitized, air-dry, and stored.
item.ifNotReady: Do not use a cracked, deeply cut, or dirty board. Tell the Food Lead.
